create_fairseq_config: create a FairseqConfig instance with nested CommonConfig, DatasetConfig, and OptimizationConfig sub-configs
inspect_fairseqdataclass_attributes: inspect all attributes of a FairseqDataclass subclass using the _get_all_attributes method
get_field_metadata: get the help text, choices, or argparse alias for a dataclass field using _get_meta
configure_generation_params: configure beam search, sampling, and length penalty parameters via GenerationConfig dataclass
configure_distributed_training: configure DDP backend, pipeline parallelism, and ZeRO sharding via DistributedTrainingConfig dataclass
